function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset

message.content:
I don’t have access to real‑time data, so I can’t give you the exact current clock time in New York City right now.  

If you need the current local time, you can:

1. **Check your device’s clock** – most smartphones, computers, and smart assistants automatically adjust to the correct time zone (Eastern Time, UTC‑5 or UTC‑4 during daylight saving).  
2. **Use an online time‑zone converter** – sites like [timeanddate.com](https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/usa/new-york) or the “World Clock” feature on Google will show the live time for New York.  
3. **Ask a voice assistant** – say “What time is it in New York?” to Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa, etc.

If you’d like to see sunrise or sunset times for a specific date in New York, let me know and I can calculate those for you.
